name: Form Populate with AI
author: activity-log.com

sections.description:
Form Populate with AI enhances your WordPress site by intelligently assisting users when they fill out forms.

The plugin uses APIs provided by Typing0 AI services (https://typing0.com/).

The plugin detects supported forms on your site and can:
* Suggest values based on user input and context
* Speed up repetitive data entry
* Reduce typos and incomplete submissions
* Improve overall form completion rates and user experience

It is designed to work with standard WordPress forms and many popular form solutions. The plugin focuses on being lightweight, privacy-aware, and easy to configure.

Key Features

  • Automatic detection of supported forms
  • AI-powered suggestions to help users fill fields faster
  • Optionally pre-populate certain fields to reduce friction
  • Lightweight and optimized for performance
  • Simple settings screen – no coding required

External services

The plugin uses APIs provided by Typing0 AI services (https://typing0.com/). It sends the data you enter (text/image) and the related form structure
to the Typing0 AI service, which returns populated form data.

Typing0 Terms of Service: https://typing0.com/terms-of-service
Typing0 Privacy Policy: https://typing0.com/privacy-policy
sections.installation:
This section describes how to install the plugin and get it working automatically.

  1. In your WordPress admin dashboard, go to Plugins → Add New.
  2. Search for Form Populate with AI.
  3. Click Install Now, then click Activate.

This section describes how to install the plugin and get it working manually.

  1. Upload form-populate-with-ai.zip to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory and extract it.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to Settings → Form Populate with AI to configure basic options.
sections.faq:
What does this plugin do exactly?

Form Populate with AI helps users fill in form fields more quickly by providing AI-based suggestions and, where appropriate, pre-populating certain values. This can reduce friction, increase completion rates, and improve user experience on your site.

Does it work with all forms?

The plugin aims to work with standard WordPress forms and many popular form plugins. However, highly customized or heavily scripted forms may not be fully supported. We recommend testing on your specific setup.

Does it send my data to third-party services?

Depending on your configuration, AI suggestions may require sending minimal, relevant field content to an AI service in order to generate helpful suggestions. You should review the plugin’s settings, documentation, and your chosen AI provider’s privacy policy to ensure compliance with your own policies and applicable laws.

Is it GDPR friendly?

The plugin is built with privacy in mind, but GDPR compliance depends on how you configure the plugin and the AI provider you choose. Make sure to update your privacy policy accordingly and obtain any necessary user consents.

Will it slow down my site?

The plugin is designed to be lightweight. Any additional latency is typically limited to the time needed to request and receive AI suggestions, which usually happens asynchronously so your page remains responsive.

How can I get support?

You can use the support forum on WordPress.org to report issues or ask questions, or contact us through the Typing0 website (https://typing0.com/). Please include as much detail as possible about your WordPress version, theme, and other plugins.
